This project uses cereal rye as an Iowa COVER CROP, not a grain crop. Iowa State cover-crop recipe gives regional latest planting dates after corn harvest: Oct 21 north, Oct 28 central, Nov 7 south; Aug 15 is a broad early-season start, not a universal recommendation. Termination is in spring, not grain harvest; Iowa State advises beginners to terminate 10-14 days before corn planting, while soybean systems can be more flexible. Kc_ini/Kc_mid/Kc_end and stage lengths intentionally blank: no reliable cereal-rye-cover-crop-specific Kc/Kcb or standard stage schedule was verified. Generic FAO small-cereal values are NOT entered as measured rye-cover values. Rooting depth intentionally blank: available Weaver grain-rye values are Nebraska grain crop measurements and the Iowa fact-sheet illustration is not a measured maximum or effective extraction depth. FAO-56 Table 22 does not list cereal rye as a cover crop; root-depth range and selected value remain blank rather than using grain-rye data. Root-depth range and selected value are blank because the available grain-rye measurements are not directly transferable to an early-terminated Iowa cover crop.
